title: Arrowhead RV Park & Campground

services.name: RV site
services.desc: All our RV sites have full hookups, water, sewer, 30-amp and/or 50-amp electrical.​ Each site also has a cement pad and picnic table. Not all sites have individual fire pits, but we offer a community fire pit, down by the river where we provide the firewood. You may bring your own portable firepit or rent one at our office. Firewood is available for $5 a bundle.​ Access to all our on-site amenities, such as; hot showers, convenient coin-op laundry, a communal fire pit, nature trail, dog park, pickle ball, horseshoe pit, and remodeled rec room is included in your stay.​ ​Pets are welcome but must remain on leash at all times. Please clean up after your pets, we have provided doggy bags
